outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single representative photoactivation image series for each construct (H1.1, RCC1, H1t) in one NIH3T3 cell. The caption gives no indication of how many cells or independent experiments were imaged/repeated to obtain these representative images, so neither the number nor the type of replicates is reported, even though such representative-image panels are typically expected to state this.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin
outputs.explanation: Panel B plots fluorescence recovery/relaxation curves and inset averages with error bars, indicating that data from multiple measurements or experiments were combined. However, the caption never states how many replicates (cells, experiments, or regions) were used to generate the main curves or the averaged insets, nor what kind of replicate (biological vs. technical) they represent.
